title: Repair LifeOS COW database semantics, security, concurrency, promotion, and rollback
goal: Add a new checksum-preserving LifeOS migration after 0005/0006 and adversarial tests that make the COW branch runtime truthful and fail closed. Derive every witness inside the database from a canonical versioned preimage with extensions.ruvector_shake256_256, serialize witness heads and first promotion, enforce baseline gates, FORCE RLS tenant isolation, least-privilege grants, execution/effect provenance, full-input idempotency, base-digest insert/update/delete preconditions, canonical projection fallback, all declared conflict classes with applied resolutions, deterministic branch materialization, snapshot reconstruction and comparison, and rollback only through the active pointer's recursive promotion ancestry. Add a durable tenant-scoped mapping from (tenant_id, relation_name, member_key_digest) to a stable u64-compatible RVF vector_id, unique per tenant and retained across replacements, generations, and tombstones; reject RVF generation values above u32::MAX. Replace the existence-only capability report with a versioned acceptance-receipt gate. Keep RVF roundtrip false until the native RVF task records its receipt.
command_template: Implement the exact packet goal completely, preserve existing work, migrate disposable databases first, apply to the live database only after adversarial tests pass, and repair every in-scope local blocker.
completion_gate: Fresh bootstrap and upgrade-from-0006 both pass; adversarial concurrency, tenant, witness-tamper, idempotency, precondition, canonical-fallback, conflict-resolution, snapshot-forgery, unrelated-rollback, and privilege tests pass; the live database is migrated; migrate.rs fails closed unless the DB semantic receipt exists; capability remains false only for the explicitly pending native RVF receipt.
rollback_plan: Do not alter checksum-pinned migrations 0005/0006. Use a forward corrective migration for live state. Disposable test databases may be dropped only by exact validated names; live rows are preserved and any rollback is another additive migration.
notes: The workspace owner already granted digest-bound approval for every packet and every local blocker fix under /home/flexnetos/meta. Every shell command must use /home/flexnetos/.nix-profile/bin/rtk, with rtk proxy for raw evidence. Do not commit or push. Do not edit GitKB. GitNexus impact was CRITICAL but name-collision polluted; treat the surface as critical. Existing live COW tables were empty at audit time, but migration logic must safely handle non-empty deployments. A policy of {} must never satisfy promotion gates. lifeos_blob.object.id is not an RVF vector identity: replacements change it and sparse values can explode membership bitmaps.
